plan.notes: Pivot classes ProductionRoleAssignment and EnsembleMembership are used for reification involving time and multi-entity relations. All properties have labels/comments. Disjointness is declared for key classes.

cq_coverage.1: TheatreFestival (heldInYear, hasPremier), hasPremier or heldInYear answer when a festival took place.
cq_coverage.2: TheatreFestival (hasLocation, takesPlaceIn) points to City, which can be queried for where a festival took place.
cq_coverage.4: Theatre (locatedInCity) links a theatre to its city.
cq_coverage.5: City (locatedInCountry) links a city to its country.
cq_coverage.6: Production (basisOfProduction) links a production to its play.
cq_coverage.7: Ensemble (hasEnsembleMembership -> EnsembleMembership [ensembleMember, ensembleMembershipTime]) allows querying ensemble members at a time.
cq_coverage.10: Play (hasAct) and Act (actNumber) allow counting acts for a play.
cq_coverage.12: Production (hasReview -> Review [starRating, givenBy]) allows querying star rating by a newspaper for a production.
cq_coverage.13: Actor (employedSince) links an actor to their employment start date at a theatre.
cq_coverage.14: Production (hasProductionRoleAssignment -> ProductionRoleAssignment [productionRoleActor, productionRoleRole, productionRoleTime]) enables querying a person's roles in a production at a time.
cq_coverage.15: Production (hasPremier) is declared as functional (exactly one premier).
